{{Quote|I promised Jeryl she'd die with a detonator in one hand and a glass of brandy in the other. It seems she's made a liar of me.|The Eagle|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Jeryl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Eagle's network]] that was present at the [[Eagle's Nest]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] when the hideout was stormed by the forces of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]]. Despite attempting to get out, Jeryl was either [[Death/Legends|killed]] or [[Prisoner/Legends|apprehended]].
